summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## ARCA-61 — Plan (no changes made)  ### What I did Read the full chain end-to-end without editing anything: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `useAuth.tsx` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `db/auth.ts` (sessions) → `db/index.ts` (SQLite) → schema in `db/push.ts`.  ### What I found Everything I read is actually wired correctly: - No localStorage/sessionStorage anywhere near watchlists (only theme uses localStorage). - `WatchlistPage.tsx` only renders after `useAuth()` confirms a real user (`App.tsx` gates all pages behind `if (!user) return <LoginPage />`). - Eve
